title: Cubic Bezier Generator
description: Design custom cubic-bezier() timing functions with sliders — live curve, handles and an animated preview ball.
howto: Drag the X1/Y1/X2/Y2 sliders (or type exact values).
Watch the curve, its control handles and the preview ball update live.
Copy the cubic-bezier() snippet into your CSS transitions.

faqs.q: What do the four numbers mean?
faqs.a: The curve runs from (0,0) to (1,1). P1=(x1,y1) and P2=(x2,y2) are control points that bend it. X values must stay in 0–1 for CSS; Y can overshoot for bounce-like effects.
Presets like ease-out-back encode well-tested motion feels. Start from one, then tweak the handles to taste.

faqs.q: Where do I paste the output?
faqs.a: Into transition-timing-function or the timing slot of the animation shorthand, e.g. transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
